analysis: Examined base text units for docs/provider/cli-reference.md (base 1695-2482) against the file_changes map (range_map_complete=true). The changes are documentation only. Head 1804-1810 adds a paragraph: on a Mac running the `darkbloom cluster` service, `darkbloom update` asks the service supervisor to restart into the installed release together with the peer Mac after the pair drains. Progress is bounded by `--timeout`, and a deferral exits 1 (UpdateCommand.swift, ClusterServiceUpdateRequest). Head 2148 (base 2141) extends the `auto_update` row to say a cluster Mac uses the pair's coordinated update slot. Neither change alters the documented hash verification of the update bundle, binary or metallib in SelfUpdater.swift (base 1801-1802). Neither touches T-041 cache gates, the TB-011 App Attest authorization or the TB-012 hold socket. No secrets or new trust claims are introduced. Implementation of the cross-Mac restart request is not in the supplied evidence. Integration should check the code changes in this PR. Points to check: who may send ClusterServiceUpdateRequest to the supervisor, which local IPC/peer authentication it uses, and whether the peer Mac re-verifies the release artifact independently rather than trusting the leader (T-013/T-043 update/rollback authority). Also check whether a peer can force drain/restart loops (availability, A-018). These are unverified contracts, not findings from the docs.
